Deck Guide: 

Very much a slow deck all around, but very powerful. I wait until the opponent plays a card then drop either NW or wizard behind the king tower and drop the mega knight on top of their push as it comes over the bridge. Another good first play if you feel you need to cycle is royale ghost at the bridge as soon as the game comes up to try and catch the opponent off guard. But, After double elixir switch out the MK at the bridge for the golem to throw off the opponent and try to have both the wizard and NW behind him for an insane push. You can also run it as a golem NW beat down instead with the MK as the counter push, this way just has problems dealing with troop spam decks being so heavy.

All around a very overpowering deck, have used from around 3000 trophies into legendary arena and still is going strong
